definitions.gloss: words of resentment; reproach; bitter complaint
definitions.explanation: Words expressing a grudge or accumulated resentment toward someone, usually delivered face-to-face or in a letter. Implies a personal grievance rather than general complaining.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{一言|ひとこと}も{恨|うら}み{言|ごと}を{口|くち}にしなかった。
examples.english: She did not say a single word of reproach.

examples.japanese: {別|わか}れた{後|あと}になって{長|なが}い{恨|うら}み{言|ごと}のメールが{届|とど}いた。
examples.english: After we broke up, a long resentful email arrived.

notes:
Compound of {恨|うら}み (grudge) + {言|ごと} (words). The {言|ごと} suffix forms nouns meaning "words/talk of —" ({独|ひと}り{言|ごと}, {寝言|ねごと}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {恨|うら}み{言|ごと}を{言|い}う: to voice resentment
- {恨|うら}み{言|ごと}を{並|なら}べる: to reel off complaints
- {恨|うら}み{言|ごと}を{聞|き}く: to listen to someone's grievances
- {恨|うら}み{言|ごと}{一|ひと}つ{言|い}わない: to not utter a single word of complaint

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {愚痴|ぐち}: griping — about life or circumstances in general, not directed at a specific person
- {文句|もんく}: complaint — broader; can be about a product or situation
- {悪口|わるぐち}: bad-mouthing — speaking ill of someone behind their back
